newsitem.title: FRANCE: MATIF changes quality of white sugar contract.
newsitem.headline: MATIF changes quality of white sugar contract.

text.p: French futures and options exchange MATIF said Friday it changed the quality of its white sugar contracts and added two delivery harbors.
It said that from April 16, and staring with options for delivery after October 1998, the quality would be 45 Icumsa instead of the 60 Icumsa currently used.
Icumsa stands for International Commission for Uniform Method of Sugar Analysis and is a colouring degree.
Durban in South Africa and Puerto Quetzal in Guatemala were added as delivery harbors.
